div.div: مِقْعَرٌ , (so in a copy of the A,) or ↓ مُقَعَّرٌ , like مُعَظَّمٌ [in measure], (so in the TA,) [but the former I think the correct form, being agreeable with analogy,] A man who reaches the bottoms, or utmost points, of things, or affairs. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
